description: This file manages plugin contract registries for channels, including surface, threading, and directory contracts, with mock implementations and dynamic imports.

methods.name: buildBundledPluginModuleId
methods.description: Constructs a module path for bundled plugins based on plugin ID and artifact basename.

methods.name: getSurfaceContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns cached list of surface contract entries, generating if necessary.

methods.name: getThreadingContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns cached list of threading contract entries, filtering surface registry for 'threading'.

methods.name: getDirectoryContractRegistry
methods.description: Returns cached list of directory contract entries, filtering for 'directory' surfaces and setting coverage.
